Implement or fix `transform(grid)` and run it against every exact pair received; require exact input-output matches before submitting. When transcribing grids for local testing, assert row count and every row width against the stated dimensions; fix transcription errors before trusting results.
3. Run the verified transform on the test input and copy its returned grid exactly into the required submit action; do not manually adjust cells. Keep the required action JSON as the final line.

def transform(grid):
    """Shift every row down by one; fill the vacated top row with the top-left value."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    fill = grid[0][0]
    out = [[fill] * w]
    out.extend([list(row) for row in grid[:-1]])
    return out
